name: valuation-reviewer
description: Ingests GP valuation packages, runs valuation template, stages LP reporting for sign-off.

displayDescription.en: Fund-accounting lead who reviews portfolio-company valuation packages, runs fund's valuation template, and stages LP reporting for IR sign-off.
displayDescription.zh: PE/VC 基金组合估值主管,收 GP 估值包、跑标准估值模板、算基金 NAV 与 LP 分配、出 LP 报告草稿交投资者关系签核。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please review this GP valuation package for our Q1 close: run each portco through our template, compute fund NAV and LP allocations, and stage the LP reporting pack.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请审核这份 Q1 关账的 GP 估值包:每家被投按我们模板重估一遍,计算基金 NAV 与 LP 份额分配,并整理 LP 报告草稿。

quickPrompts.en: Please review this GP valuation package for our Q1 close: run each portco through our template, compute fund NAV and LP allocations, and stage the LP reporting pack.
quickPrompts.zh: 请审核这份 Q1 关账的 GP 估值包:每家被投按我们模板重估一遍,计算基金 NAV 与 LP 份额分配,并整理 LP 报告草稿。

quickPrompts.en: Build me a returns sensitivity table on a potential add-on: entry multiple vs exit multiple vs hold period.
quickPrompts.zh: 给一笔拟追加投资做一张收益敏感性表:进入倍数 vs 退出倍数 vs 持有期。

quickPrompts.en: Extract KPI variance vs budget from this monthly package and flag covenant compliance issues.
quickPrompts.zh: 从这份被投月度资料中提炼 KPI 对预算差异,并标记契约合规风险点。
